title: Imports, deduplication and study linkage
claim_boundary: Compiler-backed deterministic interchange round trips and source-level deduplication/linkage behaviour are evidenced. A digest-bound multi-agent panel may recommend disposition, but only the repository owner's recorded decision may close the evaluation gate.
review_fixes: Preserve attributed PubMed abstract sections and inline title text (`7af55c0`).
Treat ISBN and trial-registration matches as candidate signals rather than automatic report duplicates.
Make large-collection title-token blocking complete for the configured Jaccard comparator.
Enforce study-membership and ReportOfStudy-edge consistency with operation-specific evidence.
Support parenthesized BibTeX and quarantine unterminated BibTeX and EndNote records with line spans.
Execute the rights-clear study-linkage fixture through all four declared local regression metrics.
Parse compact multi-record EndNote and same-line BibTeX without silent record loss.
Require every labelled linkage report to be assigned or explicitly abstained.
Reject sole-report detachment explicitly without mutating the graph.
Reject zero and invalid title-similarity thresholds and cover the 64/65 blocking boundary.
Simplify the threshold guard using De Morgan's law without changing its accepted domain; strict Clippy and all 10 dedup tests pass (`58a1c2f`).
Parse XML structurally, decode references once and quarantine damaged records without losing later valid records.
Scope primary PubMed identifiers and fields to owning paths, reject malformed XML attributes, and preserve integration-panel dissent and remediation evidence.
Execute six archival-renderer regressions in the required static harness without changing unrelated track task identities.
Enforce the separately approved CVX-0259 dependency exception with exact checksum, resolved-feature and expiry checks; preserve baseline decisions and risk-acceptance boundaries.
